state.description: Article lifecycle state. Returned for authorized callers; may be omitted or redacted for public-facing responses depending on visibility rules.

published_at.description: Publication timestamp when the article was published to public listings. Null for drafts or unpublished items (maps to discussion_board_articles.published_at).

category.description: Primary category summary for the article (nullable). Maps to discussion_board_articles.discussion_board_category_id; null when uncategorized.

tags.description: Array of tag summaries applied to the article. Server returns [] when no tags are assigned.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.ISummary.description: Lightweight attachment metadata used in article responses. Maps to discussion_board_attachments. Includes signed downloadUrl/cdnUrl fields for client consumption; these are nullable when access is restricted or attachment is quarantined.

original_filename.description: Original filename provided by the uploader (discussion_board_attachments.original_filename).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the attachment (discussion_board_attachments.mime_type). Examples: 'image/png', 'application/pdf'.

is_image.description: Indicates whether the attachment is an image (discussion_board_attachments.is_image).

created_at.description: Upload timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) (discussion_board_attachments.created_at).

uploader.description: Optional summary of the uploading member for attribution. Nullable when uploader was removed or anonymized. Maps to discussion_board_attachments.discussion_board_member_id.

downloadUrl.description: Signed, time-limited download URL (CDN or storage proxy). Provided to authorized clients instead of exposing raw storage_key. Null when the attachment is quarantined or access is restricted.

cdnUrl.description: Optional CDN URL for the attachment when publicly available. Nullable when a signed download URL is used instead or when access is restricted.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.ICreate.description: Create DTO for discussion_board_articles. The authenticated actor is derived from the JWT; do NOT include discussion_board_member_id in the request body. Attachments are created via separate endpoints and linked after article creation. Reference fields use slugs (codes) instead of UUIDs per API relation rules.

title.description: Article title (min 5, max 250 characters). Server validates length and rejects invalid values with 400.

content.description: Article body content. Raw markdown or plain text allowed. Server sanitizes/filters executable content before rendering. Minimum 10 chars, maximum 200000 chars.

category_slug.description: Optional primary category slug (discussion_board_categories.slug). Prefer a lower-case, URL-friendly slug (e.g., 'economics'). The server will resolve the slug to the DB id and validate existence and active state. Nullable when no category is provided.

tag_slugs.description: Optional array of tag slugs (discussion_board_tags.slug). Max 10 tags. Server resolves slugs to tag ids transactionally, validates tag existence and active flag, and enforces the max-10 rule. Clients should send canonical slugs; server normalizes when necessary.

oneOf.description: Draft state. Article remains private to the author until published.

Request to publish. When 'published' is requested the server verifies the actor's eligibility (email verified). On successful publish the server sets published_at to current time. The server MAY override this requested state to 'pending_review' if moderation/automated signals require review.
Article will be created in a pending moderator review state and will not be visible publicly until cleared.
Hidden state typically used by moderators. Clients should not request this state unless authorized.

state.description: Optional requested initial lifecycle state. The server enforces lifecycle rules (authorization, moderation signals) and sets server-managed timestamps (e.g., published_at) when applying state transitions.

IDiscussionBoardArticle.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for discussion_board_articles. All fields are optional; only editable fields are accepted. Do NOT include id, discussion_board_member_id, created_at, or deleted_at. Server persists a snapshot into discussion_board_article_snapshots prior to applying updates for audit/versioning. Reference fields use slugs (codes) instead of UUIDs per API relation rules.

title.description: Updated article title. Subject to the same length constraints as on create. Server records a pre-update snapshot before applying changes.

content.description: Updated article body content. Server records a pre-update snapshot for audit/versioning. Server enforces sanitization and edit-window constraints.

category_slug.description: Optional primary category slug to change the article's category. Server resolves the slug to the DB id and validates existence and active state. Nullable to clear category.

Move content into pending moderator review. Server records snapshot and marks item as not public while pending.
Hide content (moderator/admin action). Server enforces authorization for this transition.

state.description: Change lifecycle state. Server enforces edit-window, role checks, and persists a snapshot before applying the change for audit/history. Unauthorized callers may receive 403.

is_pinned.description: Set pinned state. Restricted: only moderators/admins may change pinned state. Server MUST enforce authorization and audit any changes to this flag. Clients without elevated privilege MUST NOT attempt to set this field.

tag_slugs.description: Optional array of tag slugs to reconcile article tag assignments as part of the update. Server MUST reconcile the discussion_board_article_tags junction table transactionally: add new assignments, remove absent ones, validate tag existence and active state, and enforce max 10 tags.

IDiscussionBoardArticleSnapshot.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and paginating article snapshots. NOTE: author_username is a convenience filter (resolved server-side to a member id via join); the server must validate existence and enforce moderator-only usage for performance-sensitive queries. When used with a path-scoped endpoint that already provides articleId in the URL, clients SHOULD NOT include article_id in the body; the server will validate and reject conflicting values.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Max 100.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating the attachments collection of an article. Expresses the final desired ordered list of attachments for the article. The endpoint MUST enforce per-article limits (max 5 attachments; max 3 image attachments). Attachment entries MUST follow the discriminated union defined in IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry (each item MUST include `kind`).

Validation and business rules enforced by the server:
- Per-article limits: maximum 5 attachments; maximum 3 images among those attachments. The server MUST reject the request with 400 if limits are exceeded.
- Per-file constraints: images MUST be one of (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp) and image file size MUST be <= 5,242,880 bytes (5 MB). Non-image documents MUST be one of (application/pdf, text/plain, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document) and size MUST be <= 20,971,520 bytes (20 MB).
- Atomicity: the request is validated as a whole. If any item fails validation (missing required fields, invalid storage_key, disallowed mime_type, or size violation), the server MUST reject the entire request and apply no changes.
- Storage-key verification: for kind='new' entries the server MUST verify that `storage_key` points to a persisted object in the storage system and that the object passed malware/abuse scanning before marking the attachment available for public visibility.
- Removal behavior: when attachments are removed from the article as part of this update, the server MAY schedule asynchronous storage cleanup tasks, but MUST NOT perform irreversible immediate deletion in the synchronous request. Permanent deletion must follow data-lifecycle retention rules.

attachments.description: Ordered array representing the final attachments state for the article. Each item MUST be a discriminated object with property `kind` set to either 'existing' or 'new'. The server enforces business rules: max 5 items total and at most 3 images among them. The articleId is the path parameter and MUST NOT be included in items.

remove_storage.description: Optional flag indicating whether removed attachments should be scheduled for storage cleanup. True indicates implementation may enqueue storage deletion tasks for attachments that were removed by this update. NOTE: storage cleanup is asynchronous and permanent removal MUST respect the system's data-lifecycle retention rules (e.g., quarantine/soft-delete windows). Default: false.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry.description:
Discriminated union for an attachment update entry. Each item MUST include the discriminator property `kind` which selects the variant.

- kind='existing' (IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry.Iexisting): associate or reorder an existing attachment by its persisted `id` (discussion_board_attachments.id).
- kind='new' (IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry.Inew): create/associate a new attachment metadata record referencing a pre-uploaded storage object (storage_key).

The server MUST validate the presence and correctness of the `kind` property before applying variant-specific validation. Use the mapping below to determine which variant to validate against.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.ICreate.description: Create DTO for article attachments. Used when the client provides upload metadata (pre-signed direct upload) or when the server persists metadata after handling multipart uploads. Note: articleId is provided in the path and uploader member id is derived from the authenticated session, therefore those fields MUST NOT be supplied in this request body.

storage_key.description: Object storage key/URI where the uploaded file resides (for direct-upload flows) or a server-assigned storage key returned for multipart uploads. The server MUST validate that the storage_key references an existing persisted object and that scans completed successfully before creating the DB metadata record.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating the file is an image; the server may infer this from mime_type. When true the server will enforce the stricter image size limit (<= 5,242,880 bytes). This field is optional because the server will derive the authoritative value from mime_type and content inspection.

IDiscussionBoardComment.description: Comment entity returned by the API representing a discussion_board_comments row. Includes soft-delete state (deletedAt) and moderation visibility (isHidden). Maps to Prisma model discussion_board_comments.

articleId.description: Identifier of the parent article (discussion_board_articles.id). This value is supplied by the path parameter when creating/listing comments and is used to scope the comment (maps to discussion_board_comment.discussion_board_article_id).

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment id (discussion_board_comments.discussion_board_parent_comment_id). Nullable for root comments or when parent was removed.

author.description: Author summary object derived from discussion_board_author_id. Nullable when the author account was anonymized or removed. The server sets author from the authenticated user when creating comments.

content.description: Comment body text. Server enforces content length and sanitization. Business rule: max 500 characters for MVP; server must validate and sanitize before persisting.

isHidden.description: Indicates whether the comment is hidden due to moderation or automated heuristics (maps to discussion_board_comments.is_hidden). Controlled by moderation systems; clients must not set this field.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_comments.created_at.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_comments.updated_at.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp (discussion_board_comments.deleted_at). Nullable; presence indicates the comment was soft-deleted and subject to retention/purge rules. Returned to authorized callers per RBAC/audit rules.

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

search.description: Full-text/trigram search applied to comment content.

authorId.description: Optional filter by author id (discussion_board_member.id). Null or omitted to disable author filtering.

oneOf.description: Optional filter to restrict results to replies of a specific parent comment (UUID).

parentCommentId.description: Optional filter to restrict results to replies of a specific parent comment. Null or omitted to include root-level comments.

includeThreaded.description: When true, server may return a threaded representation (tree) where supported; otherwise a flat list is returned. Default: false.

oneOf.description: Sort order for results: createdAt ascending.
Sort order for results: createdAt descending.

includeHidden.description: When true and caller is authorized (moderator/admin), include comments with is_hidden = true. Public callers MUST NOT receive hidden comments; the server MUST ignore this flag for public callers and require elevated privileges to honor it. Access to hidden content should be audited.

includeDeleted.description: When true and caller is authorized (moderator/admin), include soft-deleted comments (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Public callers must not receive deleted records; servers must enforce RBAC and audit accesses returning deleted items.

createdFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound filter for comment created_at (ISO 8601 datetime). Nullable; when provided server MUST validate createdFrom <= createdTo if createdTo is present.

createdTo.description: Inclusive upper bound filter for comment created_at (ISO 8601 datetime). Nullable; when provided server MUST validate createdFrom <= createdTo if createdFrom is present.

IDiscussionBoardComment.IRequest.description: Request DTO for listing comments of a specific article. Supports pagination, optional search, author/parent filters, threaded representation, sorting and date-range filters. NOTE: The articleId MUST be supplied as the path parameter and MUST NOT appear in the request body. The server enforces exclusion of path parameters from the body and will return 400 on duplication. Moderator-only flags (includeHidden, includeDeleted) require elevated privileges and must be audited when honored.

IDiscussionBoardComment.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a comment on an article.
Security: This operation requires an authenticated member (authorizationActor: "member"). The server WILL set the author id from the authenticated JWT; clients MUST NOT supply author id. The article id is supplied as a path parameter and MUST NOT be duplicated in the request body.
Business rules: content is required and must respect product length constraints (application-enforced; max 500 characters). parentCommentId is optional and, when provided, must reference a comment in the same article and not produce a reply depth exceeding configured limits.

content.description: Comment body text. Required. Must respect product policy length constraints (application-enforces max length, e.g., 500 characters).

oneOf.description: Optional identifier of the parent comment to create a reply. Server will validate that the parent exists, belongs to the same article, and that reply depth does not exceed policy.
Explicit null indicates a root-level comment.

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment id (UUID) or null. Matches nullable DB column discussion_board_parent_comment_id.

IDiscussionBoardComment.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing comment. Only mutable fields are present. Ownership and edit-window checks are enforced by the server; clients MUST NOT attempt to modify article association or parent reference. All fields are optional; unspecified fields are left unchanged. Server enforces edit-window and content length policy (max 500 characters) and records audit entries; clients MUST NOT provide author identifiers.

content.description: Updated comment text. The server enforces edit-window and content validation. Use omission to leave content unchanged. When provided, content must be between 1 and 500 characters (business-authoritative limit from Business Rules).

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISumma.description: Public-safe summary representation of a comment attachment. Use this schema for public listing and article/comment detail endpoints. This variant intentionally omits the internal `storageKey` and exposes time-limited `downloadUrl`/`cdnUrl` when access is permitted. Fields reflect Prisma nullability: uploader is nullable.

originalFilename.description: Original filename as supplied by the uploader.

mimeType.description: MIME type for the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).

isImage.description: True if the attachment is an image type.

quarantined.description: Indicates whether the attachment is quarantined. Public consumers must not receive download links for quarantined attachments.

createdAt.description: Upload timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

downloadUrl.description: Signed, time-limited download URL. Provided only when the caller is authorized and the attachment is not quarantined. Null otherwise.

cdnUrl.description: Optional public CDN URL for the attachment when publicly available. Nullable when not provided or access restricted.

uploader.description: Optional uploader summary for attribution; nullable when the uploading member was anonymized or removed.

storage_key.description: Object storage key or URI referencing a previously uploaded file. Clients MUST upload the binary to configured object storage before referencing the key here. The server will validate that the storage_key resolves to an existing, persisted object and that storage metadata (size, content-type) matches the submitted values before creating the attachment metadata record.

original_filename.description: Original filename supplied by the uploader at time of upload. This value is stored in discussion_board_comment_attachments.original_filename and used for display, export and download filename hints.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported on upload (e.g., image/png, application/pdf). The server validates allowed MIME types (images: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp; documents: application/pdf, text/plain, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet). The server may override this value if content inspection reveals a different type.

size.description: File size in bytes as reported by the client. The server validates this value against configured per-file size limits and against the persisted storage object's metadata. Business limits applied by the server: images SHOULD be <= 5,242,880 bytes (5 MB); non-image documents up to 26,214,400 bytes (~25 MB). The server is authoritative and will reject mismatches or oversized files.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating whether the file is an image. The server will infer is_image from mime_type/content and is authoritative for image-specific processing (thumbnailing, stricter size limits). Clients MAY provide this as a hint but the server may ignore or override it.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ICreat.description: Single manifest item used when creating comment attachments. References a pre-uploaded storage object via `storage_key`. Required metadata (original_filename, mime_type, size) is enforced so the server can validate and persist a discussion_board_comment_attachments row. Clients MUST NOT supply server-managed fields such as `quarantined`, `created_at` or `discussion_board_uploaded_by_id`. The server will run malware/abuse scans and, if flagged, will set `quarantined = true` and not expose a public download URL to regular callers.

attachments.description: Array of attachment manifest items referencing pre-uploaded storage objects. The server enforces per-comment attachment quota (MVP: max 1) atomically within a DB transaction. Clients MUST upload files to storage and then reference the resulting storage_key here. The server will validate mime_type and size, run malware/abuse scans, and set `quarantined = true` for flagged files. Clients MUST NOT include path parameters (articleId, commentId) in the body, nor server-managed fields (quarantined, created_at, discussion_board_uploaded_by_id). On success the server returns attachment summaries (IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISummary) that include signed publicUrl/cdnUrl when available; raw storage_key is never returned to public callers.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ICreat.description: Create request body for adding attachments to a comment. This request references pre-uploaded storage objects and supplies minimal metadata required for server-side validation and persistence. Quarantined attachments will be recorded with quarantined=true and will not include public download URLs for non-privileged callers. The server is responsible for ownership checks (author or moderator), atomic quota enforcement, scan invocation, and audit logging.

storage_key.description: Object storage key or URI referencing an already-persisted file in the configured object storage. Required. Must reference an existing persisted object; the server will validate presence, accessibility and scan results before creating the attachment metadata record. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.storage_key.

original_filename.description: Original filename supplied by the client at upload time. Stored in discussion_board_comment_attachments.original_filename and used for display and export.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported on upload (e.g., image/png, application/pdf). The server validates allowed mime types and may override based on content inspection. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.mime_type.

size.description: File size in bytes as reported by the client. Server validates this value against configured per-file size limits and against the persisted storage object's metadata. Conservative maximum = 25,242,880 bytes (25 MB) to align with documented business constraints. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.size.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating whether the file is an image. Server will infer authoritative value from mime_type and file inspection and will persist to discussion_board_comment_attachments.is_image. Inclusion is optional; omit or set null when unknown.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.IReque.description: Manifest item used for patch/update operations referencing a pre-uploaded storage object. Clients MUST upload binary to object storage first and then reference the resulting storage_key here. The server validates the storage_key, enforces allowed mime types and size limits, runs malware/abuse scanning, and may set quarantined=true for flagged items. DO NOT supply uploader or actor identifiers; the server derives the uploading member from the authenticated session.

attachments.description: Array of manifest items referencing pre-uploaded storage objects to create or update attachment metadata for the target comment. For MVP the server enforces a per-comment quota: max 1 attachment (minItems=1, maxItems=1). Do NOT duplicate path parameters (articleId, commentId) in the body. Clients MUST NOT include actor/session identifiers (e.g., discussion_board_uploaded_by_id) or quarantine flags; those are server-managed.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.IReque.description: Request body for patching (add/update) attachments for a comment. Each attachments entry's storage_key MUST reference an already persisted object; the server will validate existence, run malware/abuse scans, create discussion_board_comment_attachments rows and enforce per-comment quotas. The server sets discussion_board_comment_attachments.discussion_board_uploaded_by_id from the authenticated session and will audit creation.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.description:
Internal/detailed attachment metadata mapped to the Prisma model discussion_board_comment_attachments.

INTERNAL USE ONLY: This schema includes internal fields (storageKey) that MUST NOT be returned on public endpoints. Use IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISummary for any public or guest-facing responses. This detailed representation is intended for moderator/admin/internal consumers only and access MUST be privilege-gated and audited.

commentId.description: Identifier of the parent comment this attachment belongs to (maps to discussion_board_comment_id).

Provide signed `downloadUrl`/`cdnUrl` to public callers instead.

quarantined.description: True when the attachment is quarantined for malware or policy reasons. Quarantined attachments must not expose downloadUrl/cdnUrl to public callers.

downloadUrl.description: Signed, time-limited URL for downloading the file via CDN/object-storage proxy. Provided to authorized clients or public consumers when the attachment is not quarantined. Null or omitted for quarantined attachments or when the caller is not authorized.

cdnUrl.description: Optional CDN URL for the attachment when available. Nullable when not provided or access restricted.

uploader.description: Optional summary of the uploading member for attribution. Nullable when uploader was removed. Prefer exposing this summary to public clients rather than raw uploadedById.

reporterMemberId.description: Filter reports submitted by a specific member (UUID). Nullable; only honored for authorized moderator callers.

createdFrom.description: Start of createdAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

createdTo.description: End of createdAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

discussion_board_report_id.description: Optional reference to an originating report (discussion_board_reports.id). Nullable when the action is not tied to a specific report.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.description: Detailed moderation action record returned by the API. IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.ISummar.description: Summary view of a moderation action. Includes key scalar properties and a summary object for the acting moderator. This type is intentionally minimal to avoid circular expansion and is intended for list and embedding scenarios.

IDiscussionBoardAppeal.ISummary.description: Sanitized summary representation of an appeal. Provides actor context (appellant), current status and optional links to the moderation action and report. created_at.description: Timestamp when the appeal was submitted (ISO 8601 UTC).

resolved_at.description: Resolution timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Nullable until resolved.

oneOf.description: Optional list of statuses to filter by (e.g., ['pending']). Provide at least one status when using this filter.

IDiscussionBoardAppeal.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for modifying mutable fields of an appeal. Used by moderators to record resolutions and link moderation actions. The server enforces allowed status transitions and validates referenced moderationActionId if supplied.
