IDiscussionBoardSearch.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for global search across articles, comments, attachments and tags. Contains the required query string plus optional filters, pagination primitives (page, limit) and sorting options. NOTE: This is a REQUEST schema — do not use response pagination wrappers here. Field names use camelCase to align with API conventions.

Filters summary (see `filters` property): supported keys include:
- types: array of entity types to include (e.g., ['article','comment','attachment','tag'])
- categoryId: UUID to filter articles by primary category
- tagSlugs: array of tag slug strings to filter articles by tags
- authorUsername: exact username (discussion_board_member.username)
- createdFrom / createdTo: ISO 8601 datetimes to restrict created/published date ranges

Visibility note: Public callers MUST expect that results are already filtered server-side to exclude soft-deleted or moderation-hidden/quarantined content (deleted_at != null, state != 'published', is_hidden = true, quarantined = true).

query.description: Non-empty full-text search query used to search article titles/content, comment text, tag names and author display names. Clients must provide a non-empty string.

filters.description: Optional named filter object (IDiscussionBoardSearch.IFilters) to restrict the search results. Use camelCase keys: types (string[]), categoryId (uuid), tagSlugs (string[]), authorUsername (string), createdFrom (ISO 8601 datetime), createdTo (ISO 8601 datetime).

limit.description: Number of items per page. Server enforces a maximum of 100.

oneOf.description: Sort by relevance (default).
Sort by newest - maps to published_at desc (fallback to created_at when published_at is null).
Sort by oldest - maps to published_at asc (fallback to created_at when published_at is null).

sort.description: Sort order for results. Mapping: 'newest'/'oldest' map to published_at where applicable, otherwise created_at. Use 'relevance' for full-text scoring.

highlight.description: When true, the response may include highlighted snippets for matched fields to assist UI presentation. This may increase payload size.

basicSearch.summary: Search articles and comments for 'inflation' in economics category, pinned first page

IDiscussionBoardSearchResult.ISummary.description: Summary view of an article used in search results and listings. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_articles. This summary provides minimal fields required to render a list item and includes belongs-to references as .ISummary objects for context. Fields that are derived (excerpt, thumbnail) are optional and presentation-only. Note: author is nullable to reflect Prisma nullability when articles are anonymized or the author was removed.

title.description: Article title (short form) used for listing and search snippets.

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt or lead text derived from the article content suitable for list display. This field is presentation-derived and may be null when not computed.

author.description: Optional author summary. Nullable to reflect Prisma column discussion_board_member_id which is nullable (anonymized or removed authors).

category.description: Primary category for the article. Nullable when an article has no assigned category.

tags.description: Array of tag summaries applied to the article (classification). May be an empty array when no tags are assigned. Server SHOULD return [] rather than omitting the property.

is_pinned.description: Whether the article is pinned in listing views (matches discussion_board_articles.is_pinned).

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the article in ISO 8601 UTC (discussion_board_articles.created_at).

published_at.description: Publication timestamp when the article became public. Null for drafts.

thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail URL for the article (derived from attachments). This field is presentation-only and may be null when no thumbnail exists.

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description:
Time-series and summary metrics of article activity (articles, comments, attachments) for the requested date range.

Notes:
- All aggregates exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) and moderation-hidden records (articles where state != 'published' or comments with is_hidden = true).
- Date bucketing uses UTC calendar days (ISO 8601 date string, YYYY-MM-DD). Server SHOULD normalize timestamps to UTC before bucketing.
- average_comments_per_article is a nullable number: null when article_count is zero; otherwise a floating-point value (presentation may round to 2 decimal places).

summary.description: Overall summary metrics computed for the requested range. Counts are integer totals for the range and exclude soft-deleted/hidden items.

article_count.description: Total number of published articles in the period (excludes soft-deleted or hidden items).

comment_count.description: Total number of comments in the period (excludes deleted or hidden comments).

attachment_count.description: Total number of attachments uploaded in the period (excludes deleted/quarantined attachments).

average_comments_per_article.description: Computed as comment_count / article_count when article_count > 0. Null when article_count == 0 to avoid division by zero. Use floating point; recommended client presentation: round to two decimal places.

time_series.description: Array of daily aggregation buckets for the requested date range, ordered by date descending. Each bucket contains day-level counts (UTC calendar day).

top_tags.description: Top tags used across articles in the period ordered by usage count. Each item contains tag display name, slug and usage count. May be an empty array when no tags were used.

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description: Daily aggregation bucket representing counts for a single calendar day within the requested range.

date.description: Calendar day in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) representing the bucket date.

article_count.description: Number of published articles on this day (excludes soft-deleted/hidden).

comment_count.description: Number of comments created on this day (excludes deleted/hidden).

attachment_count.description: Number of attachments uploaded on this day (excludes deleted/quarantined).

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description: Summary of a tag and its usage count within the requested period. Derived from discussion_board_article_tags join with discussion_board_tags. Counts exclude associations to soft-deleted or hidden articles.

slug.description: Tag slug (discussion_board_tags.slug). Use canonical slug for filtering/URLs.

count.description: Number of times the tag was used in the requested period (non-negative integer).

IDiscussionBoardArticlesMonthlyStatistic.description: Monthly aggregated statistics for discussion_board_articles. Each object represents a calendar month (represented as the month-start timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC) and includes counts broken down by state and derived metrics. Implementation note: published_count is computed by grouping rows where discussion_board_articles.published_at is not null using DATE_TRUNC('month', published_at); draft_count is computed from discussion_board_articles in the 'draft' state using DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) because drafts typically have published_at = null. The aggregation MUST exclude rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL. Implementers should document these two separate bucketing strategies (published_by_published_at vs drafts_by_created_at) and consider precomputing materialized views for large datasets.

month.description: Month bucket represented as the month-start ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC (e.g., '2025-10-01T00:00:00Z'). Use this canonical representation for ordering and display.

published_count.description: Number of articles that were published in this calendar month. Computed by grouping discussion_board_articles by DATE_TRUNC('month', published_at) and counting rows where state = 'published' and deleted_at IS NULL.

draft_count.description: Number of articles that were in 'draft' state created in this calendar month. IMPORTANT: drafts typically have published_at = null, so this value is computed by grouping discussion_board_articles by DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) and counting rows where state = 'draft' and deleted_at IS NULL. This explicit semantic avoids the common mistake of attempting to derive draft counts from published_at buckets.

pending_review_count.description: Number of articles that were in 'pending_review' state during the chosen month. Implementation may choose to count items whose state was 'pending_review' at any time in the month or to count snapshots; document the chosen semantics. Exclude rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

hidden_count.description: Number of articles that were in the 'hidden' state during the month (typically due to moderation or automated hide). Exclude rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

distinct_authors_published.description: Count of unique discussion_board_member_id values for articles published in the month (used as denominator when computing per-author averages). Excludes null/anonymous authors and rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

average_published_per_author.description: Derived metric computed as published_count / greatest(distinct_authors_published, 1). Implementations should compute this as a floating-point value and document the rounding strategy used (e.g., 2 decimal places).

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.IRequest.description: Search request for discussion_board_audit_logs. Contains optional filters, full-text search over the metadata column (GIN/trigram), pagination and sorting. Intended for privileged moderator usage; caller identity is taken from authentication context and must not be supplied here. Date range filters map to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp and are inclusive.

eventType.description: Exact-match filter for event_type (for example: 'auth.login', 'moderation.action'). Server may validate against known event types.

actorType.description: Filter by actor_type (for example: 'member','moderator','system'). Use only known classifications. Caller must be authorized to filter by actor-related fields.

actorId.description: Filter by actor_id (UUID). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.actor_id. This filter exposes PII and MUST be honored only for callers with appropriate privileges; accesses should be audited.

resourceId.description: Filter by resource_id (UUID). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.resource_id. Use only when caller is authorized to query resource-level audit events.

fullText.description: Free-text search applied to the metadata column (serialized JSON) using the DB GIN/trigram index. This is a privileged operation: queries may be rate-limited, results may be redacted for PII, and full payload access may require elevated permissions.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for event_timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

dateTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for event_timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Default is 1. Server enforces a minimum of 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default 20. Server MUST enforce an upper bound (recommended max 100) to protect the system and avoid extremely large synchronous responses.

sort.description: Sort expression. Typical values: 'event_timestamp' (ascending) or '-event_timestamp' (descending). Server validates supported sort keys.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.ISummary.description: Concise summary of an audit-log entry (discussion_board_audit_logs). Intended for listing and triage. The full serialized metadata payload is intentionally excluded from this summary. To retrieve full event_payload callers require an elevated/detail endpoint and appropriate privileges; such accesses MUST be audited.

id.description: Primary key: unique identifier of the audit log entry (discussion_board_audit_logs.id).

event_type.description: Canonical event type describing the audited event (for example: 'auth.login','moderation.action'). Use dot notation for hierarchical classification when applicable.

event_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Corresponds to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

resource_type.description: Optional resource type targeted by the event (for example: 'article','comment','attachment'). Nullable for system-level events.

resource_id.description: Optional UUID of the resource targeted by the event (discussion_board_audit_logs.resource_id). Nullable when no resource is targeted.

actor_type.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action (for example: 'member','moderator','system'). Nullable for system events.

actor_id.description: Actor identifier (UUID) when applicable (discussion_board_audit_logs.actor_id). May be null when actor was anonymized or when event is system-generated. This field may contain PII and should be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges; the server MUST log accesses to unredacted audit responses.

created_at.description: Record insertion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). For audit semantics this is typically set by the application and corresponds to discussion_board_audit_logs.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Audit records are append-only and updates are exceptional; this field is nullable and mirrors discussion_board_audit_logs.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Administrative soft-delete timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Presence indicates the record has been administratively marked; use is restricted by policy. Mirrors discussion_board_audit_logs.deleted_at.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.description: Append-only audit log entry mapped to the Prisma model `discussion_board_audit_logs`. Contains canonical forensic snapshot of a system or user event. The `metadata` property contains serialized JSON text (string) and may be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges. All timestamps use ISO 8601 UTC format.

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit record (UUID).

event_type.description: Canonical event type (e.g. 'auth.login','moderation.action','export.request'). Use dot notation for hierarchical classification.

event_timestamp.description: Time when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC).

resource_type.description: Optional resource type the event targets (e.g., 'article','comment','attachment'). Null when event is system-level with no resource.

resource_id.description: Optional UUID of the target resource. Interpreted according to resource_type; may be null for non-resource events.

oneOf.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).

actor_type.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).

actor_id.description: Optional actor identifier (UUID) when applicable. Nullable for system events or anonymized actors. THIS FIELD MAY BE REDACTED in responses returned to callers without unredacted-audit privileges; when redacted the API SHOULD return null and record the access in audit-access logs.

ip.description: Observed IP address for the event when available. May be redacted for callers without unredacted privileges. Consider storing in logs but returning null to non-privileged API clients.

user_agent.description: User agent or client hint captured at event time. May be null or redacted for non-privileged callers.

metadata.description: Serialized event payload stored as JSON text (string) containing event-specific details for forensic reconstruction. MAY contain PII and therefore MUST BE REDACTED for callers without unredacted-audit privileges. Recommended consumer guidance: attempt to parse the string as JSON if present. Keep payloads reasonably sized; extremely large payloads should be truncated or referenced via external forensic storage.

created_at.description: Record insertion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). For audit semantics this is typically set by the application to match event_timestamp where possible.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp. Audit records are append-only and updates are exceptional; updates should be rare and audited. In many implementations updated_at == created_at for append-only entries unless an authorized correction occurred.

deleted_at.description: Optional administrative soft-delete marker. Use is restricted by policy.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLogAccess.IRequest.description: Request body for listing audit-log-access entries. Contains pagination, filtering and optional date range filters. Do NOT include the auditLogId in the body; it is provided in the path.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Default is 1. Server enforces sensible maxima to prevent expensive queries.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default is 20. Server may enforce a lower maxLimit for heavy queries.

oneOf.description: Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

accessorType.description: Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

accessorId.description: Optional filter for a specific accessor id (UUID). If provided the server SHOULD apply appropriate authorization and PII redaction rules.

accessPurpose.description: Optional filter by declared access purpose (for example: 'appeal_review','legal_request'). Values are implementation-defined and may be normalized by the server.

accessedFrom.description: Optional start of accessedAt range (inclusive) in ISO 8601 UTC. When both accessedFrom and accessedTo are provided the server SHOULD validate accessedFrom <= accessedTo.

accessedTo.description: Optional end of accessedAt range (inclusive) in ISO 8601 UTC.

sortBy.description: Optional explicit sort key. Supported values: 'accessedAt','-accessedAt','createdAt','-createdAt'. A leading '-' indicates descending order. When provided, server may ignore separate 'order' parameter if the sortBy value contains sign prefix.

order.description: Optional sort direction. Allowed values: 'asc' or 'desc'. When sortBy uses a sign prefix (e.g., '-accessedAt'), the sign takes precedence. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility but servers SHOULD prefer signed sortBy tokens.

id.description: Primary key of the audit-log-access record (UUID).

auditLogId.description: Referenced audit log record id (discussion_board_audit_logs.id). This value is provided to correlate the access record with its parent audit log entry.

accessedAt.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was accessed (ISO 8601 UTC).

oneOf.description: Classification of the accessor. Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact tokens for filtering and RBAC checks.
Classification of the accessor. Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact tokens for filtering and RBAC checks.
Classification of the accessor. Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact tokens for filtering and RBAC checks.
Classification of the accessor. Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact tokens for filtering and RBAC checks.

accessorType.description: Classification of the accessor. Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact tokens for filtering and RBAC checks.

accessorId.description: Polymorphic actor identifier when applicable (UUID). Nullable when system or anonymous access. **PII NOTICE**: This field contains PII and must be redacted (returned as null or omitted) for callers without unredacted-audit privileges. Access to unredacted accessorId must itself be audited.

accessorRole.description: Accessor role at time of access (e.g., 'moderator','audit_viewer'). Nullable.

accessPurpose.description: Declared business reason for access (for example: 'appeal_review','legal_request'). Implementation may normalize or canonicalize purpose values.

ip.description: Origin IP address observed for the accessor session, when available. **PII NOTICE**: This is sensitive and may be redacted for non-privileged callers.

userAgent.description: User agent string captured at access time, when available. May be redacted for non-privileged callers.

metadata.description: Optional JSON payload (stored as text) with contextual details about the access (for example: query parameters, filters used). May contain sensitive data and therefore MAY be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges; access to raw metadata must be gated by RBAC and audited.

createdAt.description: Record insertion time for the access event (ISO 8601 UTC).

IDiscussionBoardAuditLogAccess.description: Audit-log-access snapshot mapping to the Prisma model discussion_board_audit_log_accesses. Contains a record of when an audit log entry was accessed and contextual metadata. Sensitive fields (accessorId, ip, userAgent, metadata) must be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges; access to unredacted payloads must itself be recorded in the audit trail.

eventType.description: Filter by audit eventType (for example: 'moderation.action','report.filed'). Exact-match string or null to disable this filter. Nullable; server validates values against known event types.

moderationActionId.description: Filter by moderationActionId (UUID) to find entries related to a specific moderation action. Nullable when not provided.

reportId.description: Filter by originating reportId (UUID). Nullable when not provided.

actorModeratorId.description: Optional filter to restrict results to entries associated with a specific acting moderator (discussion_board_moderator.id). Nullable. Access to results filtered by moderator id and any returned moderator-identifying data MUST be governed by RBAC and audited by the server.

occurredFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for occurredAt (ISO 8601 date-time). Nullable.

occurredTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for occurredAt (ISO 8601 date-time). Nullable.

textSearch.description: Free-text search applied against eventPayload. PRIVILEGED: queries over eventPayload SHOULD be rate-limited and may require elevated audit privileges. Server implementations MUST enforce redaction rules for non-elevated callers and log accesses to raw payloads.

oneOf.description: Sort by occurredAt ascending.
Sort by occurredAt descending.

sort.description: Sort expression. Allowed values: 'occurredAt', '-occurredAt'. Use '-' prefix for descending order. When null or omitted, server applies default sort (usually '-occurredAt').

IDiscussionBoardModerationAudit.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching moderation audit entries. All filters are optional; UUIDs and datetimes must be validated by the server. NOTE: actor identity filters and free-text queries against eventPayload are privileged operations and should be rate-limited or restricted to elevated roles. Pagination defaults: page=1, limit=20 (max 100).

id.description: Primary identifier of the moderation audit entry (discussion_board_moderation_audit.id).

moderationActionId.description: Optional reference to the related moderation action (discussion_board_moderation_actions.id). Nullable when the audit entry is not linked to a specific action.

reportId.description: Optional reference to the originating report (discussion_board_reports.id). Nullable when the audit entry is not tied to a specific report.

actorModeratorId.description: Optional moderator actor id who triggered or is associated with the audited event (discussion_board_moderator.id). Null for system-generated events. Presence of this field in responses is privileged and may be redacted for non-elevated callers.

actorModerator.description: Optional moderator summary (IDiscussionBoardModerator.ISummary) that provides safe display context for the acting moderator. This convenience field is intended for response payloads only and MUST NOT be accepted in request bodies. Populate only when the caller is authorized to view moderator details.

eventType.description: Canonical event type describing the audited event (for example: 'report.filed','moderation.action','appeal.submitted').

eventPayload.description: Serialized event payload (JSON stored as text) containing the full snapshot of the event. MAY contain sensitive fields (PII). The service MUST enforce privilege checks: for standard moderator roles the implementation SHOULD return a redacted payload or an abbreviated snippet; for elevated administrator/audit roles the full payload may be returned. Access to raw payload MUST be logged in discussion_board_audit_log_accesses and governed by RBAC and retention policies.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC).

IDiscussionBoardModerationAudit.description: Immutable moderation audit entry recorded in discussion_board_moderation_audit. Fields map directly to the Prisma model and are used for forensic reconstruction and compliance. Implementations MUST apply redaction and privilege gating to `eventPayload` and MUST log any access to raw payloads in discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.

pending_reports_24h.description: Count of reports created in the last 24 hours with status indicating they are pending triage. Non-negative integer (>= 0).

pending_reports_7d.description: Count of reports created in the last 7 days that are still pending. Non-negative integer (>= 0).

actions_breakdown.description: Breakdown of moderation actions aggregated by action_type. Each item is a key/value pair where 'key' is the moderation action_type (for example: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban') and 'value' is the integer count of actions of that type during the measurement window. Values are non-negative integers.

average_processing_times.description: Array of processing-time metrics expressed as IProcessingTime objects. Each item contains 'metric' (string) and 'value_seconds' (number). Values are measured in seconds. Example metrics: 'time_to_first_action' (seconds), 'time_to_resolution' (seconds). Servers SHOULD return averages computed over the requested aggregation window.

recent_high_priority_audits.description: Sanitized short list of recent high-priority moderation audit entries. Each entry is intentionally lightweight and MUST NOT include the full event_payload. Fields provided: id, event_type, occurred_at, short_summary. To access full audit payloads callers require elevated privileges and must use the audit detail endpoint.

generated_at.description: Timestamp when this overview snapshot was generated (ISO 8601 UTC).

IDiscussionBoardModerationOverview.description: Aggregated moderation dashboard overview combining metrics from discussion_board_reports, discussion_board_moderation_actions and sanitized moderation audit entries. This DTO is computed and does not map directly to a single Prisma model. Array properties allow empty arrays (minItems: 0) to indicate no data in the window.

key.description: Aggregation key or label. In moderation breakdown contexts this is typically the moderation action type (e.g., 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban').

value.description: Integer value associated with the key (for example, a count). Must be a non-negative integer (>= 0).

IKeyValue.description: Simple aggregation pair used for dashboards and summaries. Represents a label and its numeric count. Use this for action breakdowns, top-N lists, and similar aggregated outputs.

value_seconds.description: Numeric value of the metric measured in seconds (average over the aggregation window).

IProcessingTime.description: Representation of an aggregated processing-time metric measured in seconds.

IDiscussionBoardModerationOverview.IRece.description: Sanitized summary of a moderation audit entry for inclusion in dashboard overview lists. Designed to avoid exposing raw event_payload and sensitive data. Implementations MUST redact reporter PII and other sensitive fields from this short_summary.

id.description: Identifier of the audit entry (discussion_board_moderation_audit.id). Use UUID format.

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Use date-time format.

short_summary.description: A short, sanitized summary extracted from event_payload suitable for dashboard display. MUST NOT contain reporter PII, raw event_payload JSON, or other sensitive data. Keep concise for UI display.

IDiscussionBoardMember.IRequest.description: Request DTO for moderator/member search and pagination. Filters map to discussion_board_member fields where applicable. This DTO is used only for searching/filtering; it MUST NOT contain secrets such as password_hash. Note: 'email' filter is privileged and must only be honored for callers with elevated privileges; such accesses MUST be audited. Pagination defaults: page=1, limit=20. Server must enforce a maximum limit (recommended max = 100).

email.description: Optional exact-match filter by member email. This filter MUST be accepted only for privileged callers (moderator/admin) and each access SHOULD be recorded in discussion_board_audit_logs for accountability. Public callers must not be able to use this filter.

mfaEnabled.description: Filter by MFA enrollment state. When true, return only members with mfa_enabled = true; when false, return only members with mfa_enabled = false.

includeDeleted.description: When true include soft-deleted accounts (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Default: false.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Default is 1.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Server MUST enforce a maximum limit (recommended max = 100) to protect the database and ensure predictable pagination. Default is 20.

oneOf.description: Sort by createdAt ascending (client key). Server maps to DB created_at.
Sort by createdAt descending (client key). Server maps to DB created_at.
Sort by username ascending (client key).
Sort by username descending (client key).

sortBy.description: Sort specification using API-friendly keys (camelCase). Allowed values: 'createdAt','-createdAt','username','-username'. The server MUST validate and reject unknown values and map client keys to DB columns server-side.

search.description: Free-text search applied to username and display_name (optional).

IDiscussionBoardMember.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for discussion_board_member. All fields are optional; only editable fields are accepted. Do NOT include id, discussion_board_member_id, created_at, or deleted_at. Server persists a snapshot into discussion_board_article_snapshots prior to applying updates for audit/versioning.

display_name.description: Optional public display name mapping to Prisma column discussion_board_member.display_name. Use this field to update the member's public display name. Note: API surface uses camelCase in some endpoints; this DTO intentionally uses the canonical persisted property name `display_name` to ensure cross-variant consistency with other member DTOs that expose the persisted column name.

password.description: New plain-text password. Must meet password policy: minimum 12 characters and at least three of the following categories: uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, symbol. The server MUST validate strength, hash the password server-side, and MUST NOT return the password or password_hash in any response. On successful password change the server SHOULD revoke refresh sessions when revokeSessions is true (or per policy) and record an audit entry (without including the raw password).

revokeSessions.description: Optional flag indicating whether the server should revoke all active sessions/refresh tokens for the member after a successful password change. When omitted or false, existing sessions remain subject to server policy. When true the server SHOULD expire discussion_board_member_sessions.expired_at for active sessions or otherwise revoke refresh credentials and record the action in audit logs.

username.description: Optional partial or exact username to search for. Server SHOULD sanitize input before using it in trigram/fuzzy queries to avoid injection and expensive scans.

email.description: Optional exact email filter. This filter is privileged: only elevated callers (moderator/admin) should be allowed to use it. Every use MUST be audited in discussion_board_audit_logs for accountability; the service SHOULD not reveal whether an email exists to unprivileged callers (avoid enumeration).

display_name.description: Optional partial display name to search for (fuzzy matching via trigram index). This property maps to the Prisma column discussion_board_moderator.display_name and aligns naming with moderator summary DTOs that expose the persisted field. Access to display_name-based searches must be logged for audit purposes when used to locate moderator accounts.

createdAtFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 datetime). Server MUST validate createdAtFrom <= createdAtTo when both are provided.

createdAtTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 datetime). Server MUST validate createdAtFrom <= createdAtTo when both are provided.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Default: 1. Server enforces page >= 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default: 20. Server enforces 1 <= limit <= 100 to protect the database and ensure predictable pagination.

oneOf.description: Sort expression. Allowed values: 'createdAt' (ascending) or '-createdAt' (descending). Server validates and rejects other values.
Sort expression. Allowed values: 'createdAt' (ascending) or '-createdAt' (descending). Server validates and rejects other values.

sort.description: Sort expression. Allowed values: 'createdAt' (ascending) or '-createdAt' (descending). Server validates and rejects other values.

IDiscussionBoardModerator.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and paginating moderator accounts. This type represents query/filter parameters and is not a direct table representation. Note: the 'email' filter is privileged and must be audited. Pagination defaults: page=1, limit=20; server must enforce limits and validate sort values.

email.description: Optional new email address for the moderator. If provided, the server MUST validate uniqueness across moderator accounts, trigger any verification flows required by policy, and persist updated_at. Example: "moderator.team@discussion.org"

displayName.description: Optional displayName (camelCase) for the moderator. Provide null to clear the display name. This property replaces the snake_case `display_name` to align with public API camelCase conventions and client SDK expectations. Example: "Alice Moderator"

IDiscussionBoardModerator.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for a moderator profile. Accepts only permitted mutable fields. Credential fields (password, password_hash) and the username path key are forbidden and MUST NOT be provided. The server MUST validate email uniqueness and set updated_at upon success.

displayName.description: Optional partial search term to match displayName (case-insensitive, trigram/fuzzy match recommended). Use null to indicate no filter.

ip.description: Exact-match filter for IP address. WARNING: Returning IPs in responses is considered PII. API implementations MUST restrict exposure of IP values to callers with explicit entitlement (moderator/admin) and MUST record access to audit logs (discussion_board_audit_logs). Use null to indicate no ip filter.

createdAtFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 datetime). When provided the server MUST validate that createdAtFrom <= createdAtTo if createdAtTo is also supplied.

createdAtTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 datetime). When provided the server MUST validate that createdAtFrom <= createdAtTo if createdAtFrom is also supplied.

includeDeleted.description: When true include soft-deleted records (deleted_at != null). Defaults to false.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Must be >= 1.

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Must be between 1 and 100. Server SHOULD enforce a conservative upper bound (100).

oneOf.description: Sort by createdAt ascending.
Sort by createdAt descending.
Sort by displayName ascending.
Sort by displayName descending.

sort.description: Sort expression. Allowed values: 'createdAt','-createdAt','displayName','-displayName'. Server MUST validate and reject other values.

IDiscussionBoardGuest.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and paginating discussionBoard guest records. Field names use camelCase to align with the API convention. Validation notes: server MUST enforce page >= 1, limit between 1 and 100, and createdAtFrom <= createdAtTo when both are present. Access to IP values in responses is privileged and must be audited.

IDiscussionBoardSubscription.description: Subscription record linking a member to a polymorphic target. API-facing DTO uses camelCase property names and transforms member FK to a member summary for response safety. Fields mirror the Prisma model while using API naming conventions (camelCase).

member.description: Owning member summary (replaces raw discussion_board_member_id in responses).

oneOf.description: Polymorphic target type 'article'.
Polymorphic target type 'author'.

targetType.description: Polymorphic target type. Allowed exact values: 'article' or 'author'.

targetId.description: UUID of the subscribed target (meaning depends on targetType).

oneOf.description: Deliver notifications immediately.
Accumulate notifications for a daily digest delivery.

deliveryMode.description: Delivery preference for notifications. Allowed exact values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.

lastNotifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the last notification delivered for this subscription; null when none sent.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (discussion_board_subscriptions.created_at).

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp; when present the record is considered removed for member reads. Nullable.

IDiscussionBoardSubscription.IRequest.description: Search and pagination request for listing a member's subscriptions. Do not include the member identifier in the body when member is supplied via path parameter (memberUsername). Uses camelCase for properties and documents defaults/limits.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default 20. Maximum 100.

oneOf.description: Filter: immediate delivery mode.
Filter: daily digest delivery mode.

deliveryMode.description: Optional filter for delivery mode. Exact values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.

active.description: Optional filter to return only active (true) or inactive (false) subscriptions.

search.description: Optional free-text search applied to target-related metadata (implementation-specific).

IDiscussionBoardSubscription.ICreate.description: Create DTO for discussion_board_subscriptions. The member identity is provided by the API path (memberUsername) and MUST NOT be supplied in the request body. When target_type == 'author', target_id MUST reference an existing discussion_board_member.id (UUID). When target_type == 'article', target_id MUST reference an existing discussion_board_articles.id (UUID). The server MUST enforce the database uniqueness constraint on (discussion_board_member_id, target_type, target_id) and SHOULD implement idempotent behavior (return existing subscription or 409 Conflict).

oneOf.description: Polymorphic target type: subscription to a specific article. target_id must be the article UUID (discussion_board_articles.id).
Polymorphic target type: subscription to an author. target_id must be the member UUID (discussion_board_member.id).

target_type.description: Polymorphic target type. Allowed values: 'article' or 'author'. The server MUST validate this value and resolve target_id accordingly.

target_id.description: UUID of the target resource. Interpreted according to target_type (e.g., discussion_board_articles.id when target_type='article' or discussion_board_member.id when target_type='author').

oneOf.description: Deliver notifications immediately.
Accumulate notifications for a daily digest delivery.

delivery_mode.description: Delivery preference for the subscription. Allowed values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.

active.description: Whether the subscription is active. Defaults to true when omitted.

IDiscussionBoardNotification.IBulkAction.description: Bulk action descriptor used to request a mutation on a set of notifications. Caller MUST supply the `action` property and either a non-empty `notification_ids` array OR set `apply_to_all` = true. The server MUST validate UUID formats, ownership/authorization over referenced notifications, and audit all bulk actions.

IDiscussionBoardNotification.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and bulk-managing notifications for a member. Use the path-provided memberUsername to scope results; do NOT include recipient identifiers in the body.

status.description: Optional filter by notification status. Allowed values: 'pending','sent','failed'.

subscriptionId.description: Optional filter to limit notifications to a specific subscription id (UUID).

articleId.description: Optional filter to limit notifications related to a specific article (UUID).

hasPayload.description: When true, return only notifications that have a non-empty payload.

scheduledBefore.description: Optional filter to return notifications scheduled before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

scheduledAfter.description: Optional filter to return notifications scheduled after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

q.description: Full-text search query applied to sanitized payload excerpts and related article titles.

oneOf.description: Sort expression. Allowed values: 'scheduledAt','-scheduledAt','createdAt','-createdAt'.
Sort expression. Allowed values: 'scheduledAt','-scheduledAt','createdAt','-createdAt'.
Sort expression. Allowed values: 'scheduledAt','-scheduledAt','createdAt','-createdAt'.
Sort expression. Allowed values: 'scheduledAt','-scheduledAt','createdAt','-createdAt'.

bulkAction.description: Optional bulk action to perform on the matched set. When present, the operation performs the requested mutation and returns the post-action page of results. All bulk actions MUST be audited.

notificationIds.description: Optional explicit target list of notification UUIDs for ad-hoc bulk operations. When present, bulkAction may apply to this list instead of the matched filter set.

IDiscussionBoardNotification.description: Detailed notification object representing a row from discussion_board_notifications. Relation fields are provided as summaries where helpful; raw FK columns are exposed as explicit id properties for implementer clarity. The `payload` may be null when no display payload is present. `deletedAt` is included to reflect soft-delete state in the Prisma model and is nullable.

recipientId.description: Recipient member UUID (maps to discussion_board_notifications.recipient_member_id). Non-nullable in the Prisma schema and therefore present on the DTO. Treat as PII for unprivileged callers; prefer returning `recipient` summary to UI consumers and require audit checks when exposing raw recipientId.

recipient.description: Recipient member summary (derived from discussion_board_notifications.recipient_member_id). Nullable in responses when the server intentionally redacts PII for unprivileged callers; the canonical persisted record includes recipient_member_id.

subscriptionId.description: Optional subscription UUID (maps to discussion_board_notifications.discussion_board_subscription_id). Nullable when the notification was not created from a subscription or when the subscription has been removed.

subscription.description: Optional subscription summary that produced this notification. Replaces raw FK and provides contextual .ISummary object. Nullable when notification not created by a subscription or subscription was removed.

articleId.description: Optional related article UUID (maps to discussion_board_notifications.discussion_board_article_id). Nullable when notification not related to an article or article removed.

article.description: Optional related article summary that triggered the notification. Replaces raw FK. Nullable when notification not related to an article or article removed.

oneOf.description: Opaque payload describing the notification. May contain a small JSON string with display values.

payload.description: Optional opaque payload describing the notification. May be null when no additional display payload is present. Public clients may receive a sanitized excerpt or hasPayload flag instead of full payload.

priority.description: Delivery priority (higher values are processed earlier).

oneOf.description: Timestamp of the last delivery attempt.

lastAttemptedAt.description: Timestamp of the last delivery attempt. Nullable when no attempts have been made.

nextRetryAt.description: Scheduled time for the next retry attempt (backoff). Nullable when no retry is scheduled.

scheduledAt.description: Timestamp when this notification was scheduled to be delivered (discussion_board_notifications.scheduled_at). Non-nullable in Prisma; included here.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was successfully delivered (nullable).

failReason.description: Optional short failure reason from last attempt (nullable).

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) (discussion_board_notifications.created_at).

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp if the notification was removed (discussion_board_notifications.deleted_at). Nullable.

IDiscussionBoardNotificationFailure.ISum.description: Summary representation of a single notification delivery failure attempt. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_notification_failures. This corrected summary uses the parent FK (notificationId) rather than embedding the parent notification object to prevent circular references and redundancy. Fields are presented in camelCase for API consistency. The parent notification is referenced by id (notificationId) per hierarchical-parent rule.

notificationId.description: Identifier of the parent notification (discussion_board_notifications.id). Child records MUST reference the parent by ID to avoid circular expansion (parent contains failures[]).

attemptNumber.description: Sequential attempt number for this delivery (1-based). Corresponds to discussion_board_notification_failures.attempt_number.

attemptedAt.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.attempted_at.

errorCode.description: Optional short machine-readable error code returned by the delivery channel (Prisma: discussion_board_notification_failures.error_code).

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error message captured from the delivery attempt (Prisma: discussion_board_notification_failures.error_message). Nullable.

backoffUntil.description: If present, workers should not retry this notification until this timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.backoff_until. Nullable.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.created_at.

IDiscussionBoardNotificationFailure.IReq.description: Request DTO for listing notification failure records. Contains pagination, sorting and filter criteria. Path-identifying fields (memberUsername, notificationId) MUST NOT be supplied in the body. Defaults and limits are explicit to prevent abusive queries.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Default 20. Server-enforced maximum 100 to mitigate abusive queries.

sort.description: Sort key. Allowed values: 'attemptedAt','-attemptedAt','createdAt','-createdAt'. Use '-' prefix for descending order.

errorMessageQuery.description: Full-text search query applied to errorMessage (uses trigram/GIN index). Use with caution for heavy queries.

id.description: Primary key of the notification failure record (discussion_board_notification_failures.id).

notificationId.description: Foreign key referencing the owning notification (discussion_board_notifications.id). API-facing property name (camelCase) mapped from DB column discussion_board_notification_id. Validate ownership/authorization before returning to callers.

attemptNumber.description: Sequential attempt number for this delivery (1-based). Corresponds to discussion_board_notification_failures.attempt_number.

attemptedAt.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.attempted_at.

errorCode.description: Optional short machine-readable error code returned by the delivery channel. Nullable; internal codes may be redacted for non-privileged callers.

errorMessage.description: Optional human-readable error message captured from the delivery attempt. Nullable; redact sensitive diagnostics for public callers.

backoffUntil.description: If present, workers SHOULD not retry this notification until this timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.backoff_until. Nullable when no backoff is set.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_notification_failures.created_at.

IDiscussionBoardNotificationFailure.description: Detailed delivery failure record for a single notification attempt. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_notification_failures. Fields mirror persistent columns and are intended for member/support diagnostics. Sensitive internal diagnostics beyond errorCode/errorMessage should be withheld from non-privileged callers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the setting entry (Prisma: discussion_board_settings.id).

value.description: Settings value stored as a string; consumers should parse according to expected type (boolean/number/JSON). Stored as discussion_board_settings.value.

description.description: Optional human-friendly description explaining the purpose of the setting (Prisma: discussion_board_settings.description). Nullable.

isActive.description: Flag indicating whether this setting is active and should be considered by runtime code (maps to discussion_board_settings.is_active).

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Maps to discussion_board_settings.created_at.

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Maps to discussion_board_settings.updated_at.

IDiscussionBoardSetting.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a runtime configuration setting. Maps to the Prisma model `discussion_board_settings`. This DTO provides the minimal fields required to identify and display a setting in lists or admin UIs. It excludes large structured payloads; the `value` remains a string and consumers interpret its semantic type.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLogAccess.ISummary.description: Summary view of an audit-log access event. Provides minimal information needed when embedding access records in lists or other DTOs. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit-log access record (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.id).

accessed_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log was accessed (ISO 8601 UTC) (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.accessed_at). Returned in the same naming/casing as persisted in the DTO to avoid breaking clients; some APIs use camelCase equivalents (accessedAt) elsewhere — consumers should map names as needed.

accessor_type.description: Actor classification that performed the access (e.g., 'moderator','administrator','system'). Maps to discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.accessor_type.

accessor_id.description: Polymorphic actor identifier (UUID) when applicable (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.accessor_id). Nullable when accessor is not persisted or has been anonymized. THIS FIELD CONTAINS PII and implementations MUST redact it (return null) for callers without unredacted-audit privileges.

accessor.description: Reference to the accessor summary. Polymorphic: may be a member or a moderator summary depending on accessor_type. Nullable to reflect nullable accessor_id. Use this convenience object for display; sensitive fields in the embedded summaries are already sanitized.

accessor_role.description: Accessor role at time of access (optional) — useful for retrospective RBAC checks (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.accessor_role).

access_purpose.description: Declared business reason for the access (e.g., 'appeal_review', 'legal_request') (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.access_purpose).

ip.description: IP address of the accessor session when available (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.ip). Considered sensitive PII and MUST be redacted for callers without audit entitlement. When redacted the API MUST return explicit null rather than omitting the property.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the accessor session when available (discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.user_agent). Nullable and may be redacted for callers without privilege. When redacted the API MUST return explicit null.

audit_log.description: Parent audit log summary referenced by this access record. Replaces raw foreign key discussion_board_audit_log_id for client responses. Required because underlying FK is non-nullable in Prisma.

created_at.description: Record insertion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_audit_log_accesses.created_at and is required for traceability.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAudit.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a moderation audit entry (append-only). Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_moderation_audit.

id.description: Unique identifier of the moderation audit entry (discussion_board_moderation_audit.id).

event_type.description: Canonical event type (e.g., 'report.filed','moderation.action','appeal.submitted') (discussion_board_moderation_audit.event_type). Use the exact canonical event type strings defined by the system.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC) (discussion_board_moderation_audit.occurred_at). Returned using the persisted naming to remain consistent with DB columns in other summary DTOs.

actor_moderator_id.description: Optional moderator actor id when applicable (discussion_board_moderation_audit.actor_moderator_id). Nullable for system-generated events. THIS FIELD IS PII: return null for non-privileged callers.

actor_moderator.description: Summary of the moderator who acted (if applicable). Use moderator summary to provide contextual information without exposing sensitive moderator internals. Nullable when actor_moderator_id is null. Population of this convenience field is privilege-checked by the server.

moderation_action.description: Optional reference to the moderation action related to this audit record (derived from discussion_board_moderation_audit.moderation_action_id). Nullable when not applicable or when the action has been removed. Provided as a summary object for safe embedding.

report.description: Optional reference to the report related to this audit record (derived from discussion_board_moderation_audit.report_id). Nullable when not applicable. Returned as a sanitized summary for triage UIs.

event_payload_snippet.description: Short human-readable snippet of the event payload suitable for list displays. The full serialized payload is stored in discussion_board_moderation_audit.event_payload and MAY contain sensitive information; it is returned only to callers with elevated privileges. This snippet is sanitized and free of PII.

IDiscussionBoardSubscription.ISummary.description: Lightweight subscription summary used in lists and embedded views. Transforms the member FK into a member summary (IDiscussionBoardMember.ISummary) and uses API-friendly camelCase field names for list consumers.

member.description: Owning member summary (transformed from discussion_board_member_id). Use this instead of exposing raw FK to reduce ambiguity and enable display context.

oneOf.description: Polymorphic subscription target type. Allowed values: 'article' or 'author'.
Polymorphic subscription target type. Allowed values: 'article' or 'author'.

targetType.description: Polymorphic subscription target type. Allowed values: 'article' or 'author'.

targetId.description: UUID of the subscribed target (meaning depends on targetType).

oneOf.description: Delivery preference for notifications. Allowed values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.
Delivery preference for notifications. Allowed values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.

deliveryMode.description: Delivery preference for notifications. Allowed values: 'immediate' or 'daily_digest'.

lastNotifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the last notification delivered for this subscription; null when none sent.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (discussion_board_subscriptions.created_at).

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp; when present the record is considered removed for member reads.

IDiscussionBoardNotification.ISummary.description: Summary view of a queued or delivered notification. Transforms FK references into .ISummary objects and uses camelCase for timestamps and fields to ensure consistency across DTOs.

oneOf.description: Delivery status of the notification.
Delivery status of the notification.
Delivery status of the notification.

priority.description: Delivery priority; higher values indicate earlier processing (discussion_board_notifications.priority).

scheduledAt.description: Scheduled delivery time for the notification (discussion_board_notifications.scheduled_at).

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was successfully delivered (nullable when not yet delivered).

failReason.description: Short failure reason from last attempt when status is 'failed'.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp of the notification record (discussion_board_notifications.created_at).

deliveryAttempts.description: Number of delivery attempts made for this notification (discussion_board_notifications.delivery_attempts).

lastAttemptedAt.description: Timestamp of the last delivery attempt (nullable when no attempts made).

nextRetryAt.description: Scheduled time for the next retry attempt (nullable when no retry scheduled).

recipient.description: Recipient member summary (derived relation for response DTOs).

subscription.description: Originating subscription summary when the notification was created by a subscription. Nullable when notification was generated outside a subscription or subscription was removed.

article.description: Related article summary when notification references an article. Nullable when notification not related to an article or article removed.

IDiscussionBoardMember.IRefresh.IToken.description: Variant of IDiscussionBoardMember.IRefresh that uses an opaque refresh token to obtain new access credentials. This variant MUST be selected by setting the discriminator property `type` to the exact literal value `refresh_token`. Keep property names exactly as defined: `refresh_token` (snake_case) to remain compatible with existing schema consumers.

type.description: Discriminator value. Use exactly the literal string 'refresh_token' to identify this variant.

refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh token previously issued by the authorization endpoint. Treated as a bearer credential and MUST be validated server-side.

type.description: Discriminator. Use the literal value 'session_id' to indicate this variant.

session_id.description: Identifier of the member session (discussion_board_member_sessions.id). The server MUST verify that the referenced session exists, is not soft-deleted, and that discussion_board_member_sessions.expired_at (if set) has not passed before issuing new credentials. Clients SHOULD treat this value as an opaque UUID and not attempt to infer session metadata from it.

IDiscussionBoardMember.IRefresh.ISession.description: Variant of IDiscussionBoardMember.IRefresh that references a persisted session identifier. This variant references a persisted discussion_board_member_sessions row (session_id -> discussion_board_member_sessions.id). The server validates the session record (including expired_at) and issues new credentials only when the session is valid and active.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry..description: Associate or reorder an existing attachment row. The articleId is supplied as the path parameter; server validates the referenced attachment exists and is eligible to be associated with the target article.

kind.description: Discriminator value indicating this variant references an existing attachment row.

id.description: Existing attachment id (discussion_board_attachments.id). The server will validate the attachment exists and that it is eligible to be associated with the target article.

IDiscussionBoardAttachment.IUpdateEntry..description: Create/associate a new attachment reference that points to an already-persisted object in storage. The server will validate storage_key presence, run malware/abuse scan, and create the discussion_board_attachments row before marking the attachment available. Do NOT supply uploader or article id in this object; the server derives uploader from the authenticated session and article id from the path parameter. Note: the server enforces per-type size limits (images typically <= 5,242,880 bytes; non-image documents <= 20,971,520 bytes) and will reject items that exceed configured thresholds.

kind.description: Discriminator value indicating this variant references a new attachment via storage_key.

storage_key.description: Object storage key or path referencing the uploaded file. Must point to an existing, successfully persisted object in the configured file storage (e.g., a pre-signed upload target or storage object URI).

original_filename.description: Filename provided by the uploader at upload time. Stored in discussion_board_attachments.original_filename. The server SHOULD sanitize this value for display and export; avoid exposing raw filenames containing PII or control characters.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported for the file. Must be one of the allowed types listed. The server may perform content sniffing and override this value if the uploaded object metadata disagrees.

size.description: File size in bytes. Server validates per-file size limits before creating the metadata record. Global allowed maximum: 20,971,520 bytes (20 MB). Implementations SHOULD apply stricter image limits (<= 5,242,880 bytes) when `is_image` is true.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating whether the file is an image. The server will infer from mime_type when omitted and will apply image-specific validations (thumbnails, size limits) accordingly.

IDiscussionBoardSearch.IFilters.description: Named filter object for the global search endpoint. Extracted from inline filters to improve reusability and clarity. NOTE: public callers MUST NOT request non-public article states; servers MUST enforce visibility restrictions and audit privileged queries.

types.description: Restrict result types to one or more of the allowed entity types. If omitted, all types are searched. Each element must exactly match one of the allowed literal tokens.

categoryId.description: Filter articles by primary category id (discussion_board_categories.id). Use UUID string. Nullable when not provided.

tagSlugs.description: Filter articles by tag slugs (discussion_board_tags.slug). Provide an array of tag slug strings. Max 10 slugs to reflect article tag cardinality constraints.

authorUsername.description: Filter results by author username (discussion_board_member.username). Exact-match on username; servers resolve username to member id for DB queries.

state.description: Optional lifecycle state filter for articles. Allowed values: 'draft','published','pending_review','hidden'. Public callers MUST NOT request non-public states (draft/pending_review/hidden); server enforces privilege checks for such filters.

is_pinned.description: Optional filter to return only pinned (true) or unpinned (false) articles. Maps to discussion_board_articles.is_pinned.

createdFrom.description: ISO 8601 start datetime for date-range filtering (inclusive). Server behavior: for draft-oriented queries this filter applies to created_at; for published-oriented queries the server applies it to published_at. Clients should prefer explicit scoping where available.

createdTo.description: ISO 8601 end datetime for date-range filtering (inclusive). See createdFrom for application semantics.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.IReques.description: Search, filter and pagination parameters for moderation actions. This request DTO uses API-facing camelCase property names and restricted enum values where applicable. Intended for moderator actors; the server enforces authorization and may redact fields based on privileges.

moderatorId.description: Optional filter by acting moderator id (UUID). Maps to discussion_board_moderation_actions.moderator_id. Nullable/optional for broad queries.

reportId.description: Optional filter by originating report id (UUID).

actionType.description: Optional filter by actionType. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.

targetType.description: Optional filter by polymorphic target type. Allowed values: 'article','comment','member','attachment'.

targetId.description: Optional filter by the specific target resource id (UUID).

createdFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for createdAt when filtering by date range (ISO 8601).

createdTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for createdAt when filtering by date range (ISO 8601).

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for effectiveFrom when filtering by date range (ISO 8601).

effectiveTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for effectiveFrom when filtering by date range (ISO 8601).

q.description: Full-text search applied to actionReason (server may use trigram/full-text indexes). Use cautiously for heavy queries.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Default: 20. Server enforces an upper bound (100).

oneOf.description: Sort expression. Allowed tokens: 'createdAt', '-createdAt', 'effectiveFrom', '-effectiveFrom'. Server maps these to the corresponding DB columns.
